Name: Em's Spooky Halloween Pets
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Spooky pets for Halloween! Includes options for the cats, dogs and turtles
Available for Content Patcher and Alternative textures
Complete config options﻿, ﻿compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]
Happy Halloween!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FKJr9zMN/Spooky-Adoption.png[/img]

The different options to adopt are:
Cats: Skeleton, Scarecrow, Costume, Spirit, Ghost, Pumpkinhead
Dogs: Mummy, Bones, Spook, Lantern
Turtles: Boneshell, Pirate, Pumpkin

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]﻿

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Halloween Pets CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

To choose different spooky types:
Open ﻿the [i]config.json [/i]file in the Em's Halloween Pets mod folder
Replace the "[color=#e69138]name[/color]" with the version you like
The choice you make also affects Marnie's adoption icon
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!
﻿Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/5ySh95dL/AT.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Halloween Pets AT"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Buy the paint tools from Robin at the Carpenter's shop
With the scissors selected, left-click your pet and choose its spooky type
Enjoy!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGb2cDyd/Patchnotes.png[/img]

[i]﻿Update 1.1 Includes the adoption icons at Marnie
Update 1.2 Pets can now be disabled in the config options. Includes small script changes
[/i]
Suggestion: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37492]Em's pet adoptions﻿[/url] to adopt more pets from Marnie
Optionally use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22631]Hats On Pets Plus[/url] to adjust the placement of hats on custom animal sprites
